Type: geometric stoneware vase
Use: holding flowers or standing alone as a centerpiece; living room, dining room, on a table, console or shelf
Style: modern, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: glazed stoneware, glossy finish
Colors: white
Shape: tall tapered body widening toward the base, raised chevron faceted relief pattern, small neck, large centerpiece
Feel: crisp, bright, sculptural
Goes with: light wood, grey or white walls, greenery, brass accents; modern or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Geometric Pattern Decorative Stoneware Vase, Large Centerpiece, 12.25"H, White
product.description: Textured geometric patterns give this vase a modern, angular flair. The lovely milky white color with transparent glaze will go with any décor. Add flowers if you wish, but this vase can also stand alone as a decorative piece Neutral white with modern patterns allow it to blend with any room 100% stoneware with transparent glaze 6.25"Diameter x 12.25" H Durable stoneware vase great for display or holding flowers
